description: This is a README.md file for the 'long.js' JavaScript library. It provides a documentation overview of a class for representing 64-bit two's-complement integers in JavaScript, including usage, API, and background information.

classes.name: Long
classes.description: A class for representing 64-bit signed and unsigned integers, providing methods for creation, comparison, bitwise operations, and conversion to various formats.

methods.name: Long
methods.description: Constructor that creates a Long instance from low and high 32-bit parts, with optional unsigned flag.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Returns a new Long representing the sum of this and another Long.

methods.name: and
methods.description: Returns the bitwise AND of this Long and another Long.

methods.name: compare / comp
methods.description: Compares this Long with another Long, returning 0 if equal, 1 if this is greater, -1 if other is greater.

methods.name: divide / div
methods.description: Divides this Long by another Long.

methods.name: equals / eq
methods.description: Checks if this Long equals another Long.

methods.name: getHighBits
methods.description: Returns the high 32 bits as a signed integer.

methods.name: getHighBitsUnsigned
methods.description: Returns the high 32 bits as an unsigned integer.

methods.name: getLowBits
methods.description: Returns the low 32 bits as a signed integer.

methods.name: getLowBitsUnsigned
methods.description: Returns the low 32 bits as an unsigned integer.

methods.name: getNumBitsAbs
methods.description: Returns the number of bits needed to represent the absolute value.

methods.name: greaterThan / gt
methods.description: Returns true if this Long is greater than another.

methods.name: greaterThanOrEqual / gte / ge
methods.description: Returns true if this Long is greater than or equal to another.

methods.name: isEven
methods.description: Checks if the Long value is even.

methods.name: isNegative
methods.description: Checks if the Long value is negative.

methods.name: isOdd
methods.description: Checks if the Long value is odd.

methods.name: isPositive
methods.description: Checks if the Long value is positive or zero.

methods.name: isSafeInteger
methods.description: Checks if the Long can be safely represented as a JavaScript number.

methods.name: isZero / eqz
methods.description: Checks if the Long's value is zero.

methods.name: lessThan / lt
methods.description: Returns true if this Long is less than another.

methods.name: lessThanOrEqual / lte / le
methods.description: Returns true if this Long is less than or equal to another.

methods.name: modulo / mod / rem
methods.description: Returns this Long modulo another.

methods.name: multiply / mul
methods.description: Returns the product of this Long and another.

methods.name: negate / neg
methods.description: Returns the negation of this Long.

methods.name: not
methods.description: Returns the bitwise NOT of this Long.

methods.name: countLeadingZeros / clz
methods.description: Counts the number of leading zeros.

methods.name: countTrailingZeros / ctz
methods.description: Counts the number of trailing zeros.

methods.name: notEquals / neq / ne
methods.description: Checks if this Long differs from another.

methods.name: or
methods.description: Bitwise OR with another Long.

methods.name: shiftLeft / shl
methods.description: Shifts bits to the left.

methods.name: shiftRight / shr
methods.description: Arithmetic right shift.

methods.name: shiftRightUnsigned / shru / shr_u
methods.description: Logical right shift.

methods.name: rotateLeft / rotl
methods.description: Rotate bits to the left.

methods.name: rotateRight / rotr
methods.description: Rotate bits to the right.

methods.name: subtract / sub
methods.description: Subtracts another Long from this one.

methods.name: toBytes / toBytesLE / toBytesBE
methods.description: Converts to byte array in big or little endian.

methods.name: toInt
methods.description: Converts to 32-bit integer.

methods.name: toNumber
methods.description: Converts to nearest double.

methods.name: toBigInt
methods.description: Converts to BigInt.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts to string with optional radix.

methods.name: toUnsigned
methods.description: Converts this Long to unsigned.

methods.name: xor
methods.description: Bitwise XOR with another Long.
